objective: PhytoX — Ultimate Full-Stack Development, AI Integration, Mobile Application, GIS Intelligence, Security & Deployment Master Prompt
acceptance_criteria: R01: High-fidelity cinematic post-hero images (ground-level ecosystem and regional intelligence) with responsive formats (AVIF/WebP) and zero visual discontinuity
R02: Strict separation of Farmer and Officer portals (distinct routes, layouts, navigation, auth redirects, server-side role gating)
R03: Premium dark agricultural auth image and refined login experience with mobile keyboard friendliness
R04: Real MobileNetV2 ONNX inference pipeline (14 crops / 38 classes, 224x224), quality validation, honest uncertainty calibration, and no mock inference
R05: Dedicated mobile-first Farmer Portal with PWA manifest, bottom navigation, camera/gallery upload, EN/TE/HI language onboarding before workflow, offline status indicator
R06: Exceptional responsive adaptability across 320px, 360px, 375px, 390px, 430px, 768px, 1024px, 1280px, 1440px, 1920px viewports with zero horizontal overflow
R07: Interactive Leaflet GIS map directly embedded in Officer dashboard with markers, clustering, disease/status/time filters, and district selection
R08: Data-driven visual Officer dashboard with real KPI metrics, disease distribution charts, reporting trend lines, and potential hotspot panels
R09: Deep interactivity across both portals (tooltips, legends, date/disease filters, drill-down modals, review dialogs, loading skeletons)
R10: Live Supabase backend integration with authentic Cloudflare DNS routing, private storage signed URLs (60s TTL), atomic RPCs, and real multi-tenant persistence
R11: Application, API, database, and storage security hardening (PostgreSQL RLS negative tests, cross-region gates, file signature validation, sanitized logs)
R12: Complete farmer-to-officer end-to-end reporting and human verification loop with immutable audit trails
R13: Production deployment readiness (Vercel evaluation, FastAPI Python hosting plan, CI/CD GitHub Actions workflow, environment variable audit)
